Package com.elotouch.elopay.library.wifi

Class WifiExtender

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elotouch.elopay.library.wifi.WifiExtender
  • public final class WifiExtender
extends java.lang.Object
    API for WiFi additional configuration, including WiFi country, WiFi band, WiFi channel and other WiFi configuration.

      • setWifiEnabled

        public boolean setWifiEnabled​(boolean enabled)
        Enable or disable Wi-Fi.
        Parameters:
        enabled - true to enable, false to disable.

        false if the request cannot be satisfied; true indicates that wifi is either already in the requested state, or in progress toward the requested state.

      • setCountry

        public boolean setCountry​(@NonNull
                          java.lang.String countryCode,
                          @Nullable
                          android.os.Message resultCb)
        Set country code. If countryCode is WIFI_COUNTRY_CODE_AUTO, WiFi driver will enable 802.11d to fine-tune configuration for different country or district.

        Note: if wifi is disabled now,system will ignore request and return false

        Parameters:
        countryCode - 2 byte ASCII string. For ex: US, CA.
        resultCb - a callback message when the action is completed.if resultCb is null, don't send callback message when completed, the operation Boolean result will be put in resultCb.data with Bundle: Bundle b = new Bundle(); b.putBoolean("result", success); resultCb.setData(b);
        Returns:
        true if request is sent successfully, false otherwise.

      • getCountry

        @NonNull
public java.lang.String getCountry()

        Returns:
        countryCode 2 byte ASCII string. For ex: US, CA.

        @NonNull
public java.lang.String getDriverCountry()

      • getAvailableChannels

        @NonNull
public java.util.List<java.lang.Integer> getAvailableChannels​(int band)
        Query all the possible wifi channels for the provided band, and the channel is specified as an integer with Channel number (IEEE 802.11), i.e. channel 1 (frequency is 2412) The result depends on the country code and DFS enabled state that have been set by user.
        Parameters:
        band - as specified by one of WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_5GHZ, WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_2GHZ
        Returns:
        wifi channel id list of valid channel id, or null for error, if band is not recognized, return null.

      • getAvailableChannels

        @NonNull
public java.util.List<java.lang.Integer> getAvailableChannels​(int band,
                                                              boolean includeDfs,
                                                              @NonNull
                                                              java.lang.String countryCode)
        Query all the possible wifi channels for the provided band, and the channel is specified as an integer with Channel number (IEEE 802.11), i.e. channel 1 (frequency is 2412) The result depends the country code that have been set by user.

        Note: It is used to wifi tethering configuration when device has sim card.

        Parameters:
        band - as specified by one of WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_5GHZ, WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_2GHZ
        includeDfs - whether include DFS channels or not
        countryCode - 2 byte ASCII string. For ex: US, CA.
        Returns:
        wifi channel id list of valid channel id, or null for error, if band is not recognized, return null.

      • getEnabledChannels

        @NonNull
public java.util.List<java.lang.Integer> getEnabledChannels​(int band)
        Get the enabled wifi channel list which is used to scan with the specified band. and the channel is specified as an integer with channel number (IEEE 802.11), i.e. channel 1 (frequency is 2412).

        if user didn't configured any channel for the band, return WIFI_CHANNEL_AUTO and means scan all available channels.

        Parameters:
        band - as specified by one of WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_5GHZ, WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_2GHZ
        Returns:
        the enabled wifi channel list, if band is not recognized, return null, return WIFI_CHANNEL_AUTO if enable all available channels.

      • setEnabledChannels

        public boolean setEnabledChannels​(int band,
                                  @Nullable
                                  java.util.List<java.lang.Integer> channels)
        set the enabled wifi channel list which is used to scan with the specified band. and the channel is specified as an integer with channel number (IEEE 802.11), i.e. channel 1 (frequency is 2412)

        if channels is null or contains WIFI_CHANNEL_AUTO, means not specific channel with the specified band, system will enable all available channels automatically.

        Parameters:
        band - as specified by one of WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_5GHZ, WIFI_FREQUENCY_BAND_2GHZ
        channels - the channel list that user want to system scan
        Returns:
        true if request is handled successfully, false otherwise.

      • is80211kEnabled

        public boolean is80211kEnabled()
        Check whether 802.11K support or not

        802.11k is standard for RRM (Radio Resource Measurement), which reduces the time required to roam by allowing the client to more quickly determine which AP it should roam to next and how.

        Returns:
        true means 802.11K is enabled, false means 802.11K is disabled

      • set80211kEnabled

        public boolean set80211kEnabled​(boolean on)
        Enable/disable 802.11K

        802.11k is standard for RRM (Radio Resource Measurement), which reduces the time required to roam by allowing the client to more quickly determine which AP it should roam to next and how.

        Note: if wifi is disabled now,system will ignore request and return false

        Parameters:
        on - is a boolean representing the state that you are requesting, true for enabled, false for disabled.
        Returns:
        true if operation successfully, false the request cannot be satisfied because wifi is disabled

      • getWifiRoamRssiDiff

        public int getWifiRoamRssiDiff()
        Set the wifi roam rssi diff that is related with ini RoamRssiDiff, it is used to decide whether to Roam or not based on RSSI.

        AP1 is the currently associated AP and AP2 is chosen for roaming. The Roaming will happen only if AP2 has better Signal Quality and it has a RSSI better than AP2. RoamRssiDiff is the number of units (typically measured in dB) AP2 is better than AP1.

      • setWifiRoamRssiDiff

        public void setWifiRoamRssiDiff​(int rssiDiff)
        Set the wifi roam rssi diff that is related with ini RoamRssiDiff, it is used to decide whether to Roam or not based on RSSI.

        AP1 is the currently associated AP and AP2 is chosen for roaming. The Roaming will happen only if AP2 has better Signal Quality and it has a RSSI better than AP2. RoamRssiDiff is the number of units (typically measured in dB) AP2 is better than AP1.

        Parameters:
        rssiDiff - is a integer value representing the wifi roam rssi diff, the range from WIFI_ROAM_RSSI_DIFF_MIN to WIFI_ROAM_RSSI_DIFF_MAX

      • registerWifiExtListener

        public void registerWifiExtListener​(@NonNull
                                    WifiExtender.WifiExtenderListener callback,
                                    @Nullable
                                    android.os.Handler handler)
        Registers a callback to listen wifi extension configuration changes, Caller will receive country code, band and DFS changes. Caller can unregister a previously registered callback using unregisterWifiExtListener(WifiExtenderListener)
        Parameters:
        callback - Callback for wifi extension events
        handler - The Handler on whose thread to execute the callbacks of the callback object. If null, then the application's main thread will be used.

      • unregisterWifiExtListener

        public void unregisterWifiExtListener​(@NonNull
                                      WifiExtender.WifiExtenderListener callback)
        Allow callers to unregister a previously registered callback. After calling this method, applications will no longer receive wifi extension events about wifi additional settings
        Parameters:
        callback - Callback to unregister for wifi extension events
